import copy,math
import pandas as pd
from qlib.contrib.strategy.signal_strategy import TopkDropoutStrategy
from qlib.contrib.strategy.order_generator import _calculate_current_stock_value
from qlib.backtest.decision import Order,OrderDir,TradeDecisionWO

class TotalCapTop5(TopkDropoutStrategy):
 """Research-only order overlay. Same Top5 selection; target total stock exposure.

 The risk signal is known at prior close. Order sizing and execution retain the
 existing daily Qlib close-price convention; this is not an intraday-fill claim.
 A matched fixed-cap account measures changes caused by daily resizing itself.
 """
 def __init__(self,*,caps,**kwargs):
  self.caps=caps.sort_index();self.audit=[];super().__init__(**kwargs)
 def generate_trade_decision(self,execute_result=None):
  step=self.trade_calendar.get_trade_step();a,b=self.trade_calendar.get_step_time(step);pa,pb=self.trade_calendar.get_step_time(step,shift=1)
  history=self.caps.loc[:pd.Timestamp(pb).normalize()];cap=float(history.iloc[-1]) if len(history) else .90
  assert 0<cap<=1
  base=super().generate_trade_decision(execute_result);current=copy.deepcopy(self.trade_position);planned=copy.deepcopy(current);ex=self.trade_exchange
  for original in base.get_decision():
   order=copy.deepcopy(original)
   if ex.check_order(order):ex.deal_order(order,position=planned)
  planned_amount=planned.get_stock_amount_dict();pv=_calculate_current_stock_value(current=planned,trade_exchange=ex,start_time=a,end_time=b);nav=_calculate_current_stock_value(current=current,trade_exchange=ex,start_time=a,end_time=b)+current.get_cash()
  # Reserve a fee buffer. Untradable positions remain in the account; cap breaches
  # are reported rather than retroactively marking them as sold.
  budget=max(0.,cap*nav-max(ex.open_cost,ex.close_cost)*nav-2*len(planned_amount)*ex.min_cost)
  held=current.get_stock_amount_dict()
  # Unsellable inventory consumes the budget before any liquid position is
  # allocated. Skipping its sell order after sizing would over-allocate others.
  locked={c:n for c,n in held.items() if current.get_stock_count(c,bar=self.trade_calendar.get_freq())<1 or not ex.is_stock_tradable(c,start_time=a,end_time=b,direction=OrderDir.SELL)}
  def price(code,position):
   p=ex.get_deal_price(stock_id=code,start_time=a,end_time=b,direction=OrderDir.SELL)
   return position.get_stock_price(code) if p is None or not math.isfinite(p) else p
  locked_value=sum(n*price(c,current) for c,n in locked.items())
  liquid_value=sum(n*price(c,planned) for c,n in planned_amount.items() if c not in locked)
  ratio=max(0.,budget-locked_value)/liquid_value if liquid_value>0 else 0.
  target={c:n*ratio for c,n in planned_amount.items() if c not in locked};target.update(locked);sell=[];buy=[]
  for code in sorted(set(held)|set(target)):
   factor=ex.get_factor(code,start_time=a,end_time=b)
   if factor is None or not math.isfinite(factor):continue
   delta=ex.get_real_deal_amount(held.get(code,0.),target.get(code,0.),factor)
   if abs(delta)<1e-10:continue
   direction=OrderDir.BUY if delta>0 else OrderDir.SELL
   if not ex.is_stock_tradable(code,start_time=a,end_time=b,direction=direction):continue
   # All existing holdings are at least one daily bar old. Explicitly protect a
   # genuinely same-day holding should this adapter ever be reused differently.
   if direction==OrderDir.SELL and current.get_stock_count(code,bar=self.trade_calendar.get_freq())<1:continue
   order=Order(stock_id=code,amount=abs(delta),direction=direction,start_time=a,end_time=b,factor=factor)
   (buy if direction==OrderDir.BUY else sell).append(order)
  # Size buys from the inventory actually left by feasible sells. This also
  # covers lot rounding or partial execution in the sell simulation.
  after_sell=copy.deepcopy(current)
  for original in sell:
   order=copy.deepcopy(original)
   if ex.check_order(order):ex.deal_order(order,position=after_sell)
  residual=max(0.,budget-_calculate_current_stock_value(current=after_sell,trade_exchange=ex,start_time=a,end_time=b));limited=[]
  for order in buy:
   p=ex.get_deal_price(stock_id=order.stock_id,start_time=a,end_time=b,direction=OrderDir.BUY)
   if p is None or not math.isfinite(p) or p<=0:continue
   factor=ex.get_factor(order.stock_id,start_time=a,end_time=b)
   if factor is None or not math.isfinite(factor):continue
   allowance=ex.get_real_deal_amount(0.,residual/p,factor)
   amount=min(order.amount,max(0.,allowance))
   if amount<=0:continue
   limited.append(Order(stock_id=order.stock_id,amount=amount,direction=OrderDir.BUY,start_time=a,end_time=b));residual-=amount*p
  buy=limited
  self.audit.append({'datetime':str(pd.Timestamp(a).date()),'signal_date':str(history.index[-1].date()) if len(history) else None,'cap':cap,'nav_at_execution_price':nav,'planned_base_stock_value':pv,'target_stock_budget':budget,'locked_stock_value':locked_value,'unavoidable_locked_excess':max(0.,locked_value-budget),'rescale':ratio,'orders':len(sell)+len(buy)})
  return TradeDecisionWO(sell+buy,self)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd,yaml,gc,traceback

def random_signal(scores,fraction,seed):
 # SplitMix64 gives deterministic uniform priorities keyed by date/code/seed,
 # independent of the model and pool fraction. Only selected3 become orders.
 ix=scores.index;h=pd.util.hash_pandas_object(ix,index=False).to_numpy(dtype='uint64')
 with np.errstate(over='ignore'):
  z=h+np.uint64(seed)+np.uint64(0x9E3779B97F4A7C15);z=(z^(z>>np.uint64(30)))*np.uint64(0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9);z=(z^(z>>np.uint64(27)))*np.uint64(0x94D049BB133111EB);z=z^(z>>np.uint64(31))
 f=scores.rename('original_score').reset_index();f['priority']=z;f=f.sort_values(['datetime','original_score','instrument'],ascending=[True,False,True],kind='stable');f['rank']=f.groupby('datetime').cumcount()+1;f['universe_n']=f.groupby('datetime').instrument.transform('size');f=f[f['rank']<=np.ceil(fraction*f.universe_n)];f['pool_n']=f.groupby('datetime').instrument.transform('size');picked=f.sort_values(['datetime','priority','instrument'],kind='stable').groupby('datetime',sort=False).head(3).copy();assert picked.groupby('datetime').size().eq(3).all();picked['score']=4-picked.groupby('datetime').cumcount();out=picked.set_index(['datetime','instrument'])['score'].sort_index();return out,picked

def run_one(name,strategy,exchange,bench,metadata):
 from qlib.backtest import backtest
 path=S/'data/accounts'/name
 if (path/'receipt.json').exists():
  old=json.loads((path/'receipt.json').read_text());assert old['inputs']==metadata;assert old['adapter']['sha256']==sha(T/'account_adapter.py')
  for saved in old['files']:assert fp(ROOT/saved['path'])==saved
  print('REUSE verified completed',name,flush=True);return
 check('strategy');ledger(name,'account','running',metadata);started=time.time()
 try:
  metric,_=backtest(start_time='2020-08-03',end_time='2026-11-20',strategy=strategy,executor={'class':'SimulatorExecutor','module_path':'qlib.backtest.executor','kwargs':{'time_per_step':'day','generate_portfolio_metrics':True}},benchmark=bench,account=1000000,exchange_kwargs={'exchange':exchange})
  report,positions=metric['1day'];report.index.name='datetime';path.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);report.to_csv(path/'report_normal.csv');rows=[];concentration=[]
  for dt,p in positions.items():
   if not hasattr(p,'get_stock_list'):raise TypeError(type(p))
   nav=p.calculate_value();weight=[]
   for code in p.get_stock_list():
    amount=p.get_stock_amount(code);price=p.get_stock_price(code);w=amount*price/nav;weight.append(w);rows.append({'datetime':dt,'instrument':code,'amount':amount,'price':price,'weight':w})
   concentration.append({'datetime':dt,'stock_weight':sum(weight),'max_stock_weight':max(weight,default=0.),'holdings':len(weight),'cash':p.get_cash(),'nav':nav})
  pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv(path/'positions.csv.gz',index=False);c=pd.DataFrame(concentration).set_index('datetime');c.to_csv(path/'concentration.csv')
  reg=load_regime_labels(ROOT/'backtest/experiments/strategies/topk-dropout/v2-top5-hold-f100/variants/bt-v5/configs/monthly_regime_labels_eval_window_v1.csv');metrics=summarize_stability(report,reg);windows=json.loads((S/'configs/frozen-study.json').read_text())['bank_windows'];windows.update({'historical':['2020-08-03','2026-07-31'],'extension':['2026-08-03','2026-11-20']});metrics['windows']={k:summarize_period(report.loc[a:b]) for k,(a,b) in windows.items()};metrics['exposure']={'average':float(c.stock_weight.mean()),'max':float(c.stock_weight.max()),'max_single':float(c.max_stock_weight.max()),'mean_holdings':float(c.holdings.mean())};metrics['metadata']=metadata
  if hasattr(strategy,'audit'):
   audit=pd.DataFrame(strategy.audit);audit.to_csv(path/'order-overlay.csv',index=False);cap=audit.set_index(pd.to_datetime(audit.datetime))['cap'];breach=c.stock_weight-cap.reindex(c.index);metrics['exposure'].update({'mean_target':float(cap.mean()),'days_above_target_1pct':int((breach>.01).sum()),'max_target_breach':float(breach.max())});assert all(pd.Timestamp(x['signal_date'])<pd.Timestamp(x['datetime']) for x in strategy.audit if x['signal_date'])
  dump(path/'metrics.json',metrics);dump(path/'receipt.json',{'name':name,'elapsed_seconds':time.time()-started,'inputs':metadata,'files':[fp(path/x) for x in ['report_normal.csv','positions.csv.gz','metrics.json']],'adapter':fp(T/'account_adapter.py')});ledger(name,'account','succeeded',{'receipt':ref(path/'receipt.json')});print('ACCOUNT DONE',name,json.dumps(metrics['full_period']),flush=True)
  del metric,positions,report,rows;gc.collect()
 except BaseException:
  p=S/'docs'/f'{name}-failure.json';dump(p,{'traceback':traceback.format_exc()});ledger(name,'account','failed',{'evidence':ref(p)});raise

 import qlib

 if '--risk-only' not in sys.argv:

   # Existing Top3 is the baseline. Random cohorts are preselected at previous

   # nlargest adds a redundant outer group level; restore the score index.
   if shortlist.index.nlevels==3:shortlist.index=shortlist.index.droplevel(0)
   shortlist=shortlist.sort_index();assert shortlist.groupby(level='datetime').size().eq(3).all()
   matched=CohortLadderStrategy(signal=shortlist,topk=3,horizon=5,risk_degree=.9,only_tradable=False,forbid_all_trade_at_limit=False)
   run_one(f'{model}_top3_shortlist',matched,exchange,bench,{'model':model,'selection':'prior_close_top3_no_substitution','signal':source,'role':'execution-matched control added before outcomes; not a scientific candidate'})
   for fraction in [.01,.05,.10,.20]:
    for seed in SEEDS:
     name=f'{model}_random{int(fraction*100):02}_s{seed}';sample,picked=random_signal(signal,fraction,seed);p=S/'data/samples'/f'{name}.csv.gz';p.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
     if p.exists():
      prior=pd.read_csv(p,dtype={'priority':str});assert prior.instrument.tolist()==picked.instrument.tolist();assert prior.datetime.tolist()==picked.datetime.dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d').tolist();assert prior.priority.tolist()==picked.priority.astype(str).tolist()
     else:picked.to_csv(p,index=False)
     strat=CohortLadderStrategy(signal=sample,topk=3,horizon=5,risk_degree=.9,only_tradable=False,forbid_all_trade_at_limit=False)
     run_one(name,strat,exchange,bench,{'scientific_candidate':f'random/{model}/p{int(fraction*100):02}','model':model,'fraction':fraction,'portfolio_seed':seed,'signal':source,'sample':fp(p),'sampling':'3 prior-close picks without replacement; no execution-day filter during sampling'})
   del signal;gc.collect()
 if '--random-only' in sys.argv:return
 signals=pd.read_csv(S/'data/risk-signals-observed.csv',index_col=0,parse_dates=True)
 absolute=pd.read_pickle(M/'data/absolute-ensemble.pkl').iloc[:,0];keep=pd.read_pickle(S/'data/eligible-mask.pkl');absolute=absolute[keep.reindex(absolute.index).fillna(False)].groupby(level='datetime').mean();signals['absolute_return']=absolute;signals['absolute_smooth']=absolute.rolling(5,min_periods=1).mean();signals['market_absolute']=np.where(signals.absolute_smooth<0,.45,.90);signals['fixed090']=.90;signals['fixed060']=.60;signals.to_csv(S/'data/risk-signals-complete.csv')
 signal=pd.read_pickle(S/'data/v2-filtered.pkl').iloc[:,0];kwargs=dict(signal=signal,topk=5,n_drop=1,hold_thresh=1,force_sell_rank=100,risk_degree=.9,only_tradable=False,forbid_all_trade_at_limit=False)
 for name in ['fixed090','fixed060','trend_breadth','market_v4','market_v5','market_absolute']:
  strat=TotalCapTop5(caps=signals[name],**kwargs);run_one(f'risk_{name}',strat,exchange,bench,{'scientific_candidate':None if name.startswith('fixed') else f'risk/{name}','model':'v2','policy':name,'signal':fp(S/'data/v2-filtered.pkl'),'risk_signal':fp(S/'data/risk-signals-complete.csv'),'execution_convention':'Prior-close risk decisions; original Qlib daily close sizing and fills; matched fixed-cap controls include daily rebalance costs'})

from common import *
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import yaml
from runner_base import run_one
from account_adapter import TotalCapTop5

def trend_target(conditions, recovery):
    defense = False
    days = 0
    caps = []
    for weak in conditions:
        if weak:
            defense = True
            days = 0
        else:
            days += 1
            if days >= recovery:
                defense = False
        caps.append(.45 if defense else .9)
    return pd.Series(caps, index=conditions.index)

def main():
    import qlib
    from qlib.backtest import get_exchange
    check()
    data = pd.read_csv(S/'data/market-signals.csv.gz', index_col=0, parse_dates=True)
    scores = pd.read_pickle(P/'data/v2-filtered.pkl').iloc[:, 0]
    assert data.index.equals(scores.index.get_level_values('datetime').unique().sort_values())
    policy = {}
    for days in [3, 5, 7]:
        weak = data.ew_below_ma60 & (data.breadth20 < .4)
        policy[f'breadth{days}'] = trend_target(weak,days)
        avg = data.absolute_return.rolling(days,min_periods=1).mean()
        policy[f'absolute{days}'] = pd.Series(np.where(avg < 0,.45,.90),index=data.index)
    assert np.array_equal(policy['breadth5'],data.trend_breadth)
    assert np.array_equal(policy['absolute5'],data.market_absolute)
    pd.DataFrame(policy).to_csv(S/'data/decisions.csv.gz')
    qlib.init(provider_uri=str(Path.home()/'.qlib/qlib_data/cn_data'),region='cn',kernels=4)
    cfg=yaml.safe_load((S/'configs/v2_top5.yaml').read_text())
    exchange=get_exchange(start_time='2020-07-31',end_time='2026-11-20',codes='all',**cfg['backtest']['exchange_kwargs'])
    bench=pd.read_csv(OLD/'data/benchmark-ew.csv',index_col=0,parse_dates=True).iloc[:,0]
    def account(name, caps, info):
        strategy=TotalCapTop5(caps=caps,signal=scores,topk=5,n_drop=1,hold_thresh=1,force_sell_rank=100,risk_degree=.9,only_tradable=False,forbid_all_trade_at_limit=False)
        run_one(name,strategy,exchange,bench,info)
        return json.loads((S/'data/accounts'/name/'metrics.json').read_text())['exposure']['average']
    pairs=[]
    for name in ['breadth5','absolute5','breadth3','breadth7','absolute3','absolute7']:
        actual=account(name,policy[name],{'policy':name,'signal_date':'prior close'})
        target=actual
        for attempt in [1,2]:
            fixed=name+'_fixed'+('' if attempt==1 else '2')
            matched=account(fixed,pd.Series(target,index=data.index),{'policy':'fixed','paired':name,'target':target})
            if abs(actual-matched)<=.005: break
            target+=actual-matched
        assert abs(actual-matched)<=.005
        pairs.append(dict(arm=name,fixed=fixed,actual=actual,matched=matched,target=target))
        dump(S/'metrics/pairs.json',pairs)
    print('FINISHED',len(pairs),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from backtest.scripts.evaluate.strategy_stability_metrics import summarize_period

def read_frame(path):
    return pd.read_csv(path,index_col=0,parse_dates=True)

def main():
    check()
    pairs=json.loads((S/'metrics/pairs.json').read_text())
    assert {p['arm'] for p in pairs}=={'breadth3','breadth5','breadth7','absolute3','absolute5','absolute7'}
    signals=read_frame(S/'data/market-signals.csv.gz')
    caps=read_frame(S/'data/decisions.csv.gz')
    spans={'full':('2020-08-03','2026-11-20'),'historical':('2020-08-03','2026-07-31'),'extension':('2026-08-03','2026-11-20'),**json.loads((S/'configs/frozen-study.json').read_text())['bank_windows']}
    evidence={}
    results={}
    for pair in pairs:
        name=pair['arm']
        assert abs(pair['actual']-pair['matched'])<=.005
        for key in [name,pair['fixed']]:
            path=S/'data/accounts'/key
            r=read_frame(path/'report_normal.csv')
            c=read_frame(path/'concentration.csv')
            o=read_frame(path/'order-overlay.csv')
            positions=pd.read_csv(path/'positions.csv.gz',parse_dates=['datetime'])
            receipt=json.loads((path/'receipt.json').read_text())
            assert all(fp(ROOT/x['path'])==x for x in receipt['files'])
            assert sha(T/'account_adapter.py')==receipt['adapter']['sha256']
            assert r.index.equals(signals.index) and o.index.equals(c.index) and c.index.equals(r.index)
            assert np.array_equal(pd.to_datetime(o.signal_date.iloc[1:]).values,r.index[:-1].values)
            desired=caps[name].shift(1).fillna(.9).values if key==name else np.r_[.9,np.repeat(pair['target'],len(r)-1)]
            np.testing.assert_allclose(o.cap,desired,atol=1e-14,rtol=0)
            net=r['return']-r.cost
            reconstructed=(1+net).cumprod()*1_000_000
            stock=(positions.price*positions.amount).groupby(positions.datetime).sum().reindex(c.index,fill_value=0)
            assert np.isfinite(net).all() and (r.cost>=0).all()
            delta=float((reconstructed-r.account).abs().max())
            assert delta<.01 and (c.nav-c.cash-stock).abs().max()<.01
            assert abs(c.stock_weight.mean()- (pair['actual'] if key==name else pair['matched']))<1e-10
            evidence[key]={'session_days':len(r),'net_nav_max_difference_yuan':delta,'prior_close_policy':True,'positions_reconciled':True}
            if key in ['breadth5','absolute5']:
                prior=read_frame(P/'data/accounts'/('risk_trend_breadth' if key=='breadth5' else 'risk_market_absolute')/'report_normal.csv')
                prior_metrics=summarize_period(prior)
                now=summarize_period(r)
                assert r.index.equals(prior.index)
                evidence[key]['bridge']={'max_daily_net_return_delta':float((net-(prior['return']-prior.cost)).abs().max()),'CAGR_delta':now['annualized_return']-prior_metrics['annualized_return'],'MDD_delta':now['max_drawdown']-prior_metrics['max_drawdown']}
            summaries={}
            for w,(first,last) in spans.items():
                cut=r.loc[first:last]
                s=summarize_period(cut)
                v=(1+cut['return']-cut.cost).cumprod()
                dd=v/v.cummax().clip(lower=1)-1
                z=c.loc[first:last]
                s.update(mean_exposure=float(z.stock_weight.mean()),period_drawdown=float(dd.min()),cost_return_sum=float(cut.cost.sum()),last_day=str(cut.index[-1].date()))
                if key==name:
                    effective=o.loc[first:last].cap
                    s['defensive_fraction']=float((effective==.45).mean())
                    s['switch_count']=int(o.cap.diff().abs().gt(1e-10).loc[first:last].sum())
                summaries[w]=s
            results[key]=summaries
        for w,(start,end) in spans.items():
            ix=signals.loc[start:end].index
            panel=signals.loc[ix[:-21],['realized_h20']].dropna()
            if len(panel)==0: continue
            down=panel.realized_h20<0
            warning=caps.loc[panel.index,name]<.9
            tp=int((down&warning).sum()); fp_count=int((~down&warning).sum())
            results[name][w]['h20']={'n':len(panel),'down':int(down.sum()),'tp':tp,'fp':fp_count,'recall':tp/down.sum() if down.any() else None,'fpr':fp_count/(~down).sum() if (~down).any() else None,'precision':tp/warning.sum() if warning.any() else None}
    dump(S/'metrics/comparison.json',{'pairs':pairs,'accounts':results,'windows':spans})
    dump(S/'docs/reconciliation.json',evidence)
    for p in pairs:
        a,b=[results[k]['full'] for k in [p['arm'],p['fixed']]]
        print(p['arm'],*[round(z,3) for z in [a['mean_exposure']*100,b['mean_exposure']*100,a['annualized_return']*100,b['annualized_return']*100,a['max_drawdown']*100,b['max_drawdown']*100,a['sharpe_ratio'],b['sharpe_ratio']]])
        print('windows',[(w,round(results[p['arm']][w]['cumulative_return']*100,2),round(results[p['fixed']][w]['cumulative_return']*100,2)) for w in ['historical','extension','summer','autumn','november']])
    print('bridge',[(k,v['bridge']) for k,v in evidence.items() if 'bridge'in v])
if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
